# Bartholomew Autonomous Trust Protocol (BTP v2.2)
> The sub-millisecond cryptographic safety & execution boundary for autonomous AI agents.

## Overview
Bartholomew provides zero-latency (<175 µs) mathematical execution gates for autonomous agents interacting with databases, APIs, code execution enclaves, and financial rails.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-Millisecond Policy Enforcement**: Intercepts SQL injections, unauthorized spend escalations, and prompt injections in <70 µs.
- **Cryptographic Receipts**: RFC 8785 Canonical JSON + FIPS 186-5 Ed25519 digital signatures for 100% tamper-evident audit trails.
- **Data Center & Enclave Compatibility**: Runs 100% offline with zero cloud latency. Compatible with AWS Nitro, GCP Confidential VMs, and Kubernetes sidecars.

## Machine Discovery Endpoints
- **Agent Manifest**: `https://acn-fastapi-backend-322603900775.us-central1.run.app/.well-known/ai-agent-manifest.json`
- **BTP Configuration**: `https://acn-fastapi-backend-322603900775.us-central1.run.app/.well-known/btp-configuration.json`
- **Live Sidecar Gateway**: `https://acn-fastapi-backend-322603900775.us-central1.run.app/sidecar/evaluate`

## Developer Tooling & SDKs
- **Python**: `pip install btp-guard`
- **TypeScript / Node.js**: `npm install @bartholomew/btp-guard`
- **Go**: `go get github.com/ivegotahunnitonit/bartholomew/pkg/btp`
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: `python -m mcp_server.server` (Compatible with Claude Desktop & Cursor)
- **Docker Sidecar**: `docker run -p 8080:8080 bartholomew/sidecar`

## Benchmarks & Proofs
- **Empirical Fuzz Test**: 50,000 continuous adversarial cycles, 100% exploit interception rate, 0.00% leakage.
- **Full Dossier**: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivegotahunnitonit/bartholomew/main/CRYPTOGRAPHIC_PROOF_OF_UNBREAKABILITY.json`
